pair.title: Add a Victron device
pair.nosettings: Please fill in all the required fields.
pair.intro: Enter the details of your Victron GX device
pair.battery_info: * If you don't have a battery unitId please enter the value -1

vrm.title: Add VRM Portal device
vrm.intro: Enter your VRM Portal credentials to connect your installation
vrm.mfa_info: Only fill this field if you have activated MFA (Multi-Factor Authentication) on your VRM account
vrm.login_failed: Failed to login to VRM Portal. Please check your credentials.
vrm.required_fields: Email and password are required fields.
vrm.token_intro: Connect your installation with a VRM personal access token
vrm.token_info: Create the token in the VRM Portal:
vrm.token_step2: Go to Preferences → Integrations → Access tokens
vrm.token_step3: Add a token, name it "Homey", and copy it right away (it is shown only once)
vrm.password_deprecated: Victron is phasing out email/password logins for the VRM API. If your account uses Victron OneID, password login fails even with the correct password - use an access token.

vrm.title: Re-authenticate VRM Portal
vrm.intro: Re-enter your VRM Portal credentials to refresh the authentication token
vrm.mfa_info: Only fill this field if you have activated MFA (Multi-Factor Authentication) on your VRM account
vrm.repair_failed: Failed to re-authenticate with VRM Portal. Please check your credentials.
vrm.required_fields: Email and password are required fields.
vrm.token_intro: Paste a VRM personal access token to restore the connection
vrm.token_info: Create the token in the VRM Portal:
vrm.token_step2: Go to Preferences → Integrations → Access tokens
vrm.token_step3: Add a token, name it "Homey", and copy it right away (it is shown only once)
